stance_rationale: The draft clears the superficial multi-date alpha_scores check, but it fails hard alpha process gates: C15 is bypassed via direct parquet reads, subperiod stability is 0.278 < 0.50, and the claimed defense multi-axis sleeve collapses to Q07-only for 229 of 241 dates. These are not cosmetic issues; they undermine PIT validity, AX-exclusion validity, and incremental alpha value.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet has 241 monthly dates, no future dates, and no Date-Ticker duplicates. However score_eff is NA for 64.76% of rows; latest date has only 694 scored names out of 1813 rows, so the time-series dimension exists but the effective scored universe is materially narrower than reported.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern found; code uses align_factor_direction(.load_registry()) and Z_Score_Aligned semantics.
Direct parquet read selects only Ticker, Factor_Name, Z_Score, Coverage; Usable_Date <= sig_date is asserted but not enforced or audited.
factor_engine_proposal.R bulk-loads .cache/factor_db/factor_db_*.parquet directly and rationalizes it as load_month_factors-compatible/in spirit; C15 explicitly prohibits direct parquet load.

Regime labels are reused from WT_D20260425_007 regime_panel.parquet, whose prior artifacts describe expanding percentile and month-end apply-next-month alignment; lineage for this reuse is still missing in WT010.
Quarterly 45d and annual May lags are package claims only; the direct bulk load does not carry filing lag or Usable_Date evidence.

critical_concerns.description: C15 is a hard PIT failure: the implementation directly reads factor_db parquet files and calls that equivalent/in spirit to load_month_factors(), with only a one-factor one-month spot check. This is process bypass, not compliance.
RF-A1 fires: blended subperiod stability is 0.278 versus the 0.50 gate, with IC decaying from 0.0644 in 2008-2014 to 0.0179 in 2020-2024. The package itself marks the subperiod gate false.

The defense sleeve is not actually multi-axis after 2005-01-01: theta_defense is Q07=1 and Q25=0 for 229 of 241 dates, while Q25 standalone ICIR is negative. The AX-004/AX-005 EXCLUSION claim is therefore not sufficient and likely invalid.

RF-A2 fires: composite ICIR 0.5766 is 19.92% below the stated best single sleeve ICIR 0.72, so the blend does not prove incremental factor value. The selected 0.65/0.35 blend is also not the best tested blend by its own ICIR objective.

The final score panel silently drops most names: score_eff is missing for 64.76% of rows and latest effective coverage is 694/1813. This can distort IC, liquidity, and top-20 selection unless the scored universe mask is explicit and tested.
Liquidity filtering uses AvgTV20 at Date == sig_d with a right-aligned rolling mean, which can include same-day trading value. C10 requires no same-day liquidity data.

No challenge_note.md or artifact_lineage.json exists for WT010, and the requested risk/optimizer packages, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet are absent. AX-008 triangulation and Charter no-silent-override evidence are therefore incomplete.

Mandatory diagnostics are incomplete: monotonicity is NA, sector-neutral RF-A4 is not tested, top-decile liquidity is not exported, and PG2 correlation is replaced by proxies with STR_1656 unavailable.

The defense/cash narrative is not supported by conditional alpha: CRISIS IC is -0.071 with 95% CI [-0.1213, -0.0208], then pooled fallback is used. AX-001 requires conditional defense validation, not a pooled rescue.

supporting_arguments: RF-A7 single-snapshot risk is low: alpha_scores.parquet has 241 evenly spaced monthly sig_dates from 2004-01-01 to 2024-01-01.
Reported rank_ic 0.0502, ICIR 0.5766, and Harvey t 8.9513 exceed the nominal alpha gates.
AX-003 standalone KR value failure is avoided because the factor set does not use standalone E/P or B/P.
unresolved_disputes: No alpha_package.json final exists for WT010; only alpha_package_draft.json is present.
No WT010 challenge_note.md or artifact_lineage.json was found, so write_json -> record_lineage ordering cannot be verified.
weights.csv and covariance.parquet for WT010 were not found, so schedule validation, PSD, and condition-number checks could not be performed.
C14 and C4 remain unproven because Usable_Date and filing-lag evidence are not loaded in the factor build.
RF-A4 sector-neutral ICIR drop, RF-A5 top-decile liquidity, turnover < 600%, and direct PG2 correlation remain unverified.
Academic references do not include page-level citations, and KR-market applicability is mostly inherited from prior iterations rather than separately demonstrated here.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that the package is a valid multi-sleeve cross-family blender; in the actual theta history, the defense sleeve becomes Q07-only for 229/241 dates, while direct parquet loading bypasses the canonical PIT loader.
rebuttal_required: Rebuild alpha_scores using load_month_factors() for every month and factor, carrying Usable_Date and filing-lag evidence for C4/C14/C15.
Explain or repair subperiod stability below 0.50; do not graduate while RF-A1 remains active.
Show a pre-registered blend selection rule and reconcile why composite ICIR is below the best sleeve and below the best tested blend.
Fix the score_eff missingness or explicitly define the scored universe mask and rerun IC/liquidity diagnostics on that universe.
Provide challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, sector-neutral IC, monotonicity, top-decile liquidity, turnover, and direct PG2 correlation evidence.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Self-reported PASS fields are not enough: Codex verification finds hard C15/C14/C4 gaps, RF-A1/RF-A2 active, missing lineage/challenge artifacts, and an effective Q07-dominated sleeve despite the multi-axis claim.

alpha_specific_questions: Can this factor maintain t_NW > 2.95 in a fund-of-fund setting after using the canonical loader and counting all parent-iteration trials?
Is there any future leakage in the alpha vector once Usable_Date and filing lags are audited for all seven factors, not just asserted?
If the AX-004/AX-005 EXCLUSION depends on multi-axis quality, how is that satisfied when Q25 weight is zero for 229 of 241 dates?
Why should the 0.65/0.35 blend be accepted when RF-A2 shows it is below the best sleeve and below the best tested blend by ICIR?
